STEP ACTION 1 Obtain all standard elements of a VFR flight plan. 2 Input Information specific to LRS:
ACID Append a prefix "H" to the callsign.
Example: HN12345
Note: "H" indicates "HAZARD," much like "L" for MEDIVAC.
DEP Designated point where lake crossing begins (see FIGURE 7. LRS-DESIGNATED REPORTING POINTS).
P-Time Proposed time when lake crossing will begin.
DESTN Designated point where lake-crossing terminates (see FIGURE 7. LRS-DESIGNATED REPORTING POINTS).
ETE Time over water (designated point to designated point).
Remarks Include standard LRS remarks:
Example: LRS T1515 DESTN OSH
T1515 = Transfer time from one sector to another. (e.g., LAN-GRB)
OSH = The first point of intended landing, which may differ from the shoreline crossing designated above.
Optional Insert for the following optional remarks when applicable:
Remarks Example: LRS BLO MRA T1515 DESTN OSH XING BIG SABLE
BLO MRA = Indicates aircraft will be below the MRA and will not make 10 minute reports. SAR will commence 15 minutes after
the ETA.
XING = Used to identify shore crossing points that do not have a valid 3 letter identifier.
NEXT hhmm = Indicates next expected contact time. 3 File the flight plan.
